TOWN AND COUNTRY PLANNING ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 269)
Order under Section 6(2)(b) and Section 21(2)(b)

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 6(2)(b) and Section 21(2)(b) of the Town and Country Planning Ordinance(Chapter 269), I, Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, doby this Order : -

(a)declare that the area of land specified in the Schedule hereto shall be an Urban Development Area for thepurpose of the aforesaid Ordinance and shall be called the “Borella Sri Gothami Viharaya Sacred Area” ; and
(b)direct that an outline physical plan shall be prepared for the whole of the area declared to be the Borella SriGothami Viharaya Sacred Area.
WIMAL WEERAWANSA,Minister of Construction, Engineering Services,
Housing and Common Amenties.
Colombo,12th November 2014.
SCHEDULE
AREA COMPRISING THE BORELLA SRI GOTHAMI VIHARAYA SACRED AREA

The area of land containing in an extent of 0.7343 Hectares shown by the Survey-General's Tracing No. CO/THI/2010/555 dated 21st October 2010 (Preliminary Plan No. CO 9137) and situated in the Village of Borella (Ward No. 35 BorellaSouth within the Municipal Limits of Colombo) in the Grama Niladhari Division of Gothamipura in the Divisional Secretary'sDivision of Thimbirigasyaya in the Administrative Disrict of Colombo in the Western Province and bounded as follows :
